notes.title: Major update: 1-turn kill
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/74dd69d604aed34c0b046ea9e5e43d2153707a63.png"][/img][/p][p]The new Alpha demo will be available only between [u]25-31 August[/u]. [/p][p]So try it out fast or you'll have to wait for the next open window![/p][p][/p][h2]"1-turn kill" full focus[/h2][p][/p][p]Previously the game was designed as a potential base building / wargame multiplayer.[/p][p]Now we go [u]all in on the single player roguelike brokenness[/u] which is what makes us unique![/p][p][/p][h3][b]💥 "On a knife's edge" game balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New passive system (Traits) = whole faction blanket upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Major cost reduction for super speedy deployment[/p][/*][*][p]Brokenness can be reach by default with in-game building upgrades (like a tech tree)[/p][/*][*][p]More than 1 reward per location possible, especially high risk/reward paths[/p][/*][*][p]Last few battles can win in less than 5 turns! (feels impossible, challenging but doable!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]⭐ Onboarding experience revamp[/b][/h3][list][*][p]10-20 min max to finish the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Help player "get" the game brokenness immediately[/p][/*][*][p]Separate tutorial out from the campaign to replay[/p][/*][*][p]More in-context tutorial images[/p][/*][*][p]Gentler difficulty ramping up for player[/p][/*][*][p]Feeling of progression is strong and clear[/p][/*][*][p]Less story images[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Next step[/h2][list][*][p]More visual effects for game feel feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Full UI revamp[/p][/*][*][p]Environment art upgrades[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]See you at our demo and [url="https://discord.com/invite/YuPbsJegTd"]feedback[/url]. Thanks![/p][p]Ahsaurus team 🤘[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/4c2b8a5c84662ea61b7d8925a7ada1e60e5d9ea9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Close Alpha demo released!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/cdad1d11587aaf13f654295ba6ffbfdfafc363f8.png"][/img][/p][p]The new Alpha demo will be available only between [u]7-11 August[/u]. [/p][p]So try it out fast or you'll have to wait for the next open window![/p][p][/p][h2]The current state[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/dfd13ba7ced1d5ca993d3665048106b659847c5a.png"][/img][/p][p]Gameplay was our priority, therefore:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]✅ Ready[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Core gameplay mechanics done[/p][/*][*][p]Up to 3 hours of demo content — 1 factions, 5 maps[/p][/*][*][p]Most major UX, quality of life issues resolved[/p][/*][*][p]Competitive AI with 4 difficulty settings[/p][/*][*][p]Decent gameplay balance (as a start)[/p][/*][*][p]Low friction "Sandbox-style" tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]⚠️ Unpolished areas[/b][/h3][list][*][p]UI aesthetic[/p][/*][*][p]Many sprites are stand-in version[/p][/*][*][p]Game feel and visual effects[/p][/*][*][p]Audio[/p][/*][*][p]No settings & configurations[/p][/*][*][p]There will be bugs![/p][/*][/list][p]These will be sorted by Open Beta, after we finalise the gameplay from your feedback 🙏[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/c24c1da603d72cfdb4895b54354b66e069274d50.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]The direction[/h2][p][/p][p]From heavy playtesting, here's what we learnt:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]✨ Repeatable moments that hooked our testers[/b][/h3][list][*][p]1st impression: the art is playful, cozy and inviting[/p][/*][*][p]1st time using a broken ability (and enemies can use it too?!)[/p][/*][*][p]The fun of collecting sparkly treasures[/p][/*][*][p]"I can play the as aliens too?!" / "I will protect my alien friend at all cost!"[/p][/*][*][p]Moments of wonder and discovery on the story, treasures, and encounters in the map[/p][/*][*][p]The varied mission objectives and distinct future Campaigns[/p][/*][*][p]Exploiting tribes to attack enemies, or bribing them with food[/p][/*][*][p]Achieving the 1st broken combo setup (economy or military), start thinking "meta"[/p][/*][*][p]Playing the different factions, and finding a favourite — we have 3 solid starters, more coming![/p][/*][*][p]Stealing enemy faction's unique abilities by capturing their city[/p][/*][*][p]Mastery of advance tactics = roads, farm adjacency bonus, units, buildings etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Beating a seemingly "impossible" map — "I am a genius!"[/p][/*][*][p]Ultimately, becoming a "comfort food" game to return to (gateway to multiple TBS sub-genres)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope you find these moments of joy in our demo as well ☺️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/bdc8211bb499b379212363ba9cf25cda103b6818.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]⚒️ Key questions at close alpha[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Does this new direction have momentum and a big enough audience?[/p][/*][*][p]Right to focus on single player rather than multiplayer?[/p][/*][*][p]Potential for mods-support and editor? Are they essential at Early Access?[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]📈 Being an indie dev is hard, what we could have done better[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Share more gameplay![/p][/*][*][p]Communicate more updates[/p][/*][*][p]Should have started with a smaller game 😅[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]See you at our demo and [url="https://discord.com/invite/YuPbsJegTd"]feedback[/url]. Thanks![/p][p]Ahsaurus team 🤘[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/4c2b8a5c84662ea61b7d8925a7ada1e60e5d9ea9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Learning from Game Reveal
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/9e4fd3d3f2c6c63d20587e91b981fc52974ec65a.png"][/img][/p][p]We are extremely thankful to everyone for the feedback and support at our Steam Page launch! 🙏  [/p][p][/p][p]From what we learnt, we decided to take our game in the direction that is:[/p][list][*][p] [b]More battlefield TBS focused[/b] — learning from Advance Wars, Wargroove, Into the Breach that Steam player loves.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Less historical 4X focused[/b] — not trying to be a full-on Civilization, but extending the TBS genre by learning from Polytopia. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Important features*[/h2][list][*][p] Satisfying combat / combos game feel[/p][/*][*][p] Great replayable small map campaigns (non-dragging)[/p][/*][*][p] Exciting gameplay progressions / upgrades for Roguelite[/p][/*][*][p] Fun AI[/p][/*][*][p] More platforms & cross-platform support[/p][/*][*][p] Multiplayer + Online multiplayer matching[/p][/*][*][p] Mods support[/p][/*][*][p] Map editor (?)[/p][/*][/list][p]*TBC after play testing at demo

[/p][h2]Will not do[/h2][list][*][p] Deep city building / economy[/p][/*][*][p] Tech trees[/p][/*][*][p] Layering more systems (diplomacy, religion etc.)[/p][/*][*][p] Giant map sizes for epic empires
[/p][/*][/list][p]So don't worry the game is definitely in active development, but please do [b][u]expect changes and upgrades[/u][/b] to the direction vs what is currently on the Steam page!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/1f82e78355bdb92a211af85716866671ddd51a1e.png"][/img][/p][p]For more real-time discussions and updates, check out our [url="https://discord.gg/qPVZdnGjxN"]Discord[/url]. 
[/p][p]We'll keep you posted. See you around! 🤘
Ahsaurus team
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/4c2b8a5c84662ea61b7d8925a7ada1e60e5d9ea9.png"][/img][/p][p]
[img src=""][/img]Yes, in hindsight our game does feel more like a classic charming battlefield TBS than 4X… but hey, we're human, not dino. 😅[/p]
